name: mem0
description: Wraps mem0ai's Memory API (mem0ai/mem0, family C, BASELINE_METRIC_PLAN.md §4): ingests the conversation chunk by chunk via Memory.add() (LLM-based fact extraction/consolidation, not raw storage), then Memory.search() retrieves relevant memories per question. Comparison point for whether a real memory-agent framework beats plain RAG (bm25_rag/dense_rag) or a rolling summary (running_summary).
author: Wnsdnl
